currentParagraphText: “Fine, we’ll take you up on the offer,” the Sword Saint answered for both of them as Minaga gladly waved his hand. Instantly, the Sword Saint’s body was entirely mended inside and out, with even his resource pools getting filled up a good deal. The Unique Lifeform couldn’t cure the backlash from their boosting skills, but being a bit weaker shouldn’t be a problem if they were just going to a reunion party.
